scope: Analog-only transition replay preserving effective XSPICE truncation tolerance

engineSource.finding: When A devices are present and trtol exceeds 1, ngspice reduces it to 1 unless xtrtol overrides. The verified parent log explicitly records the reduction. Removing A devices without an explicit option restores the task default of 7.

interpretation: Preserving effective trtol=1 produces a timestep-too-small failure near the original transition without the artificial capture-end knot. Earlier completion at implicit trtol=7 is not a matched numerical control. The earlier knot/no-knot pair remains a valid sensitivity experiment at its own trtol=7. Prefix voltage differences remain, so neither trajectory identity nor identical internal failure mechanism is established.
nextAction: Use explicit effective controls for transition isolation; investigate tighter integration and the model response without relaxing accuracy budgets.
